steps.content: The Butcher tries to drape his unbearably heavy arm over your shoulder like you're his best buddy.
steps.female_content: The Butcher unceremoniously pats your shoulder like you've been friends for a long time.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Don't run away! I accidentally killed you last time. My mistake, so sorry about that! I've been waiting for you for ages.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop. Just stay where you are. Why were you waiting for me? Want to kill me again?
Blood still drips from the Butcher's ax as you warily keep your distance.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Oh come on, no need to hold a grudge against me. I understand now. You're not the Witch, just another poor soul trapped here like me.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Now that I've confirmed you're safe, I'll protect you from here on. I know how to break this curse. I just also have a <color=#fb9259>mission</color> I can't speak openly about.
He slaps his name tag loudly, as if telling you that everything is under control and to leave it all to him, then immediately waggles his eyebrows at you mysteriously.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Shhh... Look over there.
Following his gaze toward the nearby field, you notice what appears to be a human-shaped shadow crouching in the darkness among the overgrown grass.
An attacker? Or some lurking creature?
In the next instant, the Butcher drops into a fighting stance, muscles bulging in both arms as his massive ax whistles through the air.

A flash of steel, and the crouching figure in the field doesn't even have time to cry out before tumbling out of the grass. The pistol in their hand falls to the ground with a clatter. Then, before your eyes, both weapon and body melt away like candles, disappearing completely.

You're totally speechless. Was that a player? Or a villager? Perhaps they were planning to attack you, and you suppose they could be resurrected from death, but the way Clay brought down that ax showed not even a moment's hesitation.

Clay straightens up as blood drips from his ax blade onto the ground. His face and arms are splattered with crimson. He casually wipes some away, then tilts his head to study the spot where the figure had fallen, his brow furrowing slightly.
<color=#fb9259>Not this one either</color>. You hear him mutter.
A strange aura radiates from him. This player, who entered the game with you, has already been contaminated by Mania.

options: Wait and see how things unfold

steps.content: You attempt to use the shackles, but before the red light can appear, your hands are violently seized. You feel an inhuman strength from the Butcher's grip, almost crushing your hands.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: What are you trying to do?
The Butcher looms closer with an eerie calm, gradually increasing the pressure on your hands.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Don't think you're safe just because I've already killed you once. You may not be the Witch, but that strange trick of yours gives me the creeps. You understand? Don't you dare use it in front of me!
With those words, he releases your hands and tightens his grip on his ax once more.
During the ritual in the last round, your shackles made the Butcher mistake you for the Witch, and he ended up killing you and sending you back to the respawn point. Better not provoke him again.
Right now, this man's mind is consumed by his assigned mission in the story: Kill the Witch.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Strange things are happening all over this town because the <color=#fb9259>Witch</color> is hiding among the people. Only I can see through the deception. Only I can protect everyone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is killing others really your idea of protection? You're just slaughtering innocent people!
Not only is his action illogical, but it's also immoral.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Hey, hey, watch what you're saying... The ax chose me. It shows me the truth. It guides me to do what must be done.
Seeing your hesitation, he assumes you're afraid of the Witch's threat. His demeanor suddenly shifts as he cheerfully claps his large hand on your shoulder.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Are you scared? That's normal. With me here, you don't need to be afraid.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: I'll protect you. From now on, you'll stay within my sight.
And with that, he clamps his hand around yours and drags you toward the village.
